title: v8 fuzzing - 1108 potential use-after-free in RegExp code
description_snippet:
Upstream http://code.google.com/p/v8/issues/detail?id=1108

Lasse:
The RegExpExecStub is used to call generated RegExp code from JS code.
RegExp code is generally treated as C-code in its calling convention (it has no JS stack-frames, and can call directly to C functions in some cases, like stac
